{{Short description|American statistician (born 1939)}}
'''Galen Richard Shorack''' (born 14 May 1939) is an American statistician.

Shorack completed his bachelor's and master's degrees in mathematics at the [[University of Oregon]] in 1960 and 1962, respectively.<ref name="uwph">{{cite news |title=Galen R. Shorack (personal homepage) |url=https://sites.stat.washington.edu/galen/ |access-date=16 August 2023}}</ref> He then obtained a PhD in statistics from [[Stanford University]] in 1965, authoring the doctoral dissertation ''Nonparametric Tests and Estimation of Scale in the Two Sample Problem'' under the direction of [[Lincoln E. Moses]].<ref name="uwph"/><ref>{{MathGenealogy}}</ref> Shorack joined the [[University of Washington]] faculty upon earning his doctorate in 1965, and remained on the faculty until 2015, when he retired and was granted emeritus status.<ref name="uwph"/><ref name="uw">{{cite news |title=Galen R. Shorack EMERITUS, UNIVERSITY OF WASHINGTON |url=https://stat.uw.edu/about-us/people/galen-r-shorack |access-date=16 August 2023 |publisher=University of Washington}}</ref>

Shorack was elected to fellowship of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] in 1974.<ref name="uwph"/><ref name="imsfellow">{{cite news |title=Honored IMS Fellows |url=https://imstat.org/honored-ims-fellows/ |access-date=16 August 2023 |publisher=Institute of Mathematical Statistics}}</ref>
